0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_GREETING_MNAAGO_000_000
0.description: Let's each do our best, eh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_GREETING_MNAAGO_000_001
1.description: Much obliged for all the help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The soldiers' families give you their thanks as well.

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_GREETING_MNAAGO_000_002
2.description: Bugger me, being a merchant's a lot more tiring than I ever imagined! How you holding up, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_GREETING_MNAAGO_000_003
3.description: For the ones we left behind, and for the ones we've still got to look after. Let's do some good today, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_GREETING_MNAAGO_000_004
4.description: You've a heart of gold, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We could have never come this far without you.

43.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_TUTORIAL_000_000
43.description: Help M'naago achieve her goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with her and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

54.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_TUTORIAL_001_000
54.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn M'naago's trust.

55.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_TUTORIAL_001_001
55.description: With each successful delivery, M'naago will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and M'naago's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your business partner.

56.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_TUTORIAL_001_002
56.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items M'naago needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!

58.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_001_000
58.description: Ah, so you've brought me some Gyr Abanian souvenirs? Good, good. For all they preach about not being wasteful, they sure don't seem to mind wasting gil.

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_001_001
59.description: Far Eastern “antiques,” is it? Damned if I know how you can craft an antique, but the collectors don't seem to pay it any mind. If anything, this sort seems to appeal more.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_001_002
60.description: Not everybody can walk away from the Saucer with a fabulous prize. Some people even prefer these─and there are even others who won't ever bother to visit but like to pretend they did. Or maybe they've got some other reason for buying them? Who knows.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_001_003
61.description: Hah! One glance is all it takes for the memories to come flooding back. Never had a knack for weaving, but it's never too late to learn, I suppose...

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_001_004
62.description: You're a godssend─and that's no exaggeration either! I can't even begin to tell you how many ways we can put this materiel to good use...

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_002_000
63.description: Starcrack sand, is it? Superstitions notwithstanding, it has an aesthetic appeal that even our neighbors to the west can appreciate. Much obliged.

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_002_001
64.description: These days, more than a few Eorzeans have a fascination with all things Hingan bordering on obsession. Well, so long as they pay for their koban, I'll have no qualms indulging them!

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_002_002
65.description: Some of the more educated collectors say that the Near Eastern influences are quite prominent in these designs. I don't know about that, but I do know that plenty of people are happy to pay good gil for them. Or MGP, as it were.

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_002_003
66.description: Can never have too much pigment, many of our tribe's elders would say. Not that I need to tell an adventurer that! Aye, I've heard stories of how some of you lot go through enough dye to put a sultana to shame!

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_002_004
67.description: I could go on about the myriad uses of this root─mostly medicinal, mind─but let's just say we'll put it to good use.

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_003_000
68.description: My mother practically raised me on grilled Gyr Abanian chubs. Here's hoping the Gridanians appreciate this taste of home as much as I did as a child.

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_003_001
69.description: They really do look just like a piece of coral, don't they? I can see why collectors seek them out for their aquariums.

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_003_002
70.description: Little buggers may be hardy, but they need just the right conditions to form the shapes people prefer. At a glance, it seems you've brought a promising specimen...

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_003_003
71.description: Seems like you've got a good catch there! A skilled chef could cook it à la meunière...but me? Well, I suppose I could blacken it over coals or a cookfire. Edible, sure, but I can't vouch for the taste.

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_KNOWLEDGE_MNAAGO_003_004
72.description: Now this is sure to please Orella. Nothing's better for soldiers on the mend than a hearty serving of turtle soup.

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_JUDGEMENT_MNAAGO_000_000
73.description: Now then, on closer inspection... No glaring imperfections or otherwise. Solid work that passes muster. As befits an artisan such as yourself.

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_JUDGEMENT_MNAAGO_000_001
74.description: Now then, on closer inspection... Better than many such items that've passed through my hands. Even someone with my limited experience can tell the difference. Well done!

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_JUDGEMENT_MNAAGO_000_002
75.description: Now then, on closer inspection... Bugger me, you don't see something like that every day. Hells, you're lucky to see something like that once in a blue moon! I don't know what you're doing, but keep it up!

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_JUDGEMENT_MNAAGO_000_003
76.description: You've my heartfelt thanks for these, and my parents' besides. I'd like to think the tribe is doing all right these days, but every bit helps.

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_JUDGEMENT_MNAAGO_000_004
77.description: The fight never ends, friend─it just changes. The Resistance is still needed all across Gyr Abania, and contributions like yours are invaluable. Thank you!

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_FULLBAG_000_000
78.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_FULLBAG_000_001
79.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with M'naago once more.

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_BEFRANKUP_MNAAGO_000_000
80.description: Thank you so much for all your help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I think we've got enough goods to satisfy my Gridanian clients─or better yet, whet their appetite for even more!

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_BEFRANKUP_MNAAGO_001_000
81.description: That ought to do it for now, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Give me a moment to add this to our next outgoing shipment...

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_BEFRANKUP_MNAAGO_002_000
82.description: And with that, I reckon we've got more than enough for our needs! Here's hoping the folks at the Saucer are satisfied with the quality of our work...

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_BEFRANKUP_MNAAGO_003_000
83.description: Thank you so much for all your help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I think it safe to say that the tribe will be overjoyed to receive these supplies...

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_000
84.description: The Gridanian collectors send their warmest regards, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. The items you provided were quite well received, I'm told.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_001
85.description: Thanks to the contributions of you and others, we've earned enough gil to start providing payments to some of the bereaved families. In fact, a young woman from one such family is here today and would like to say a few words.

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_GERMAINNE_001_002
86.description: My name's Germainne, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>... I joined the Resistance together with my father, but when the imperials attacked the Reach, he was killed...

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_GERMAINNE_001_003
87.description: I'm grateful for what you're doing, I am. I won't deny it's been hard ever since he passed, but I wasn't expecting anything, nor do I think I deserve it...but thank you all the same.

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_GERMAINNE_001_004
88.description: I didn't want to be a soldier when I was little. I wanted to learn things, get an education. Didn't work out that way on account of the occupation, of course. That's why Father and I joined the fight.

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_GERMAINNE_001_005
89.description: But now that the occupation's ended, I've been thinking... When Ala Mhigo needed soldiers, I became one, but now Ala Mhigo needs learned men and women. So I'm thinking that's what I'll use your gil to finally become. Thank you for this opportunity, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_006
90.description: Zenos himself cut her father down when he came to the Reach that day. From what I heard, he died giving his daughter a chance to escape.

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_007
91.description: We all had to make choices that day. I was wounded, so I chose to flee with Krile and some few others. But I wanted to stay and fight─I told him, I screamed at him...

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_008
92.description: But Meffrid, he wouldn't hear it. So he stayed, and I ran. I lived, and he died.

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_009
93.description: Came to light recently that he had family too. A wife and child. He never mentioned them before, so I had no idea...

94.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_010
94.description: I'd like to help them like the other families, but we don't know where they got to, or even if they're still alive. But we'll keep on searching until we do.

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_011
95.description: In the meantime, I'll have to content myself with helping those I can─and I do hope I can continue to count on you for assistance.

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_012
96.description: This is but the first step on an endless road. Full many of our friends died, and we owe it to them to do right by their loved ones.

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_013
97.description: And we will, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─I know we will! Where there's a will, there's a way!

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_000
98.description: It's even better than we hoped, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Those Ul'dahn collectors did their best to outbid each other for our Far Eastern collectables.

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_001
99.description: The proceeds far exceeded our expectations. We've enough to expand our operations and start looking after even more families.

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_WOMAN00434_002_002
100.description: Excuse me, I'm... Well, no one of consequence, really. It was my son who fought and died for the Resistance...

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_WOMAN00434_002_003
101.description: I came to thank you for your kindness and generosity, especially at a time like this when everyone should be looking to bigger and more important challenges, like the rebuilding of our great nation.

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_WOMAN00434_002_004
102.description: My son liked to say that when the fighting was finished, he would become a merchant. He'd sell anything and everything so that he could earn money and look after me...

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_WOMAN00434_002_005
103.description: I suppose, in a way, he is now...but I'd give it all up and more if I... I'm sorry, I don't mean any disrespect for what you've done for me and mine, but...

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_WOMAN00434_002_006
104.description: Thank you, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. Good day to you.

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_007
105.description: ...Her son died when the main tower at Specula Imperatoris fell.

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_008
106.description: I was with Conrad before it happened─with him when he was urging those damn fool Skulls to lay down their arms and surrender. And he managed to do it! And then...and then...

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_009
107.description: Part of me still wonders...after, did we owe it to them to try and save them too? To dig through the rubble and try to help the ones who were trying to kill us only moments before...

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_010
108.description: Conrad would've wanted it, I know. But he was in no state to give orders, and those of us that were, well...

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_011
109.description: So he died, and they died. Conrad, our comrades. Enemies that surrendered, and those that didn't. Death all 'round and 'round.

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_012
110.description: Not that any of us had even an inkling of what was coming. Would Conrad have spent all that time negotiating if he had─would he and full many others still be alive if he had─if, if, if, sodding if!

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_013
111.description: ...Sorry. No use dwelling on it. Best to look to the here and now. To what good we've done, and what more we can do.

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_014
112.description: All this talk about Conrad...don't know if you knew, but he had a wife. I've not taken any gil to her yet─reckon she's like to refuse until she knows the others are being looked after, so I thought it best to wait.

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_015
113.description: When the time comes, though...perhaps we ought to go and see her together.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_000
114.description: Good news, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The consolation prizes we sold to the Gold Saucer turned out to be more popular than we ever imagined!

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_001
115.description: More profits means more aid for the families. In fact, we've got enough to go around now that I doubt Conrad's widow will object to taking some for herself.

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_002
116.description: Also...we found Meffrid's widow. I've a mind to visit the both of them to deliver their bit─and soon.

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_003
117.description: Think I mentioned this to you before, but I was hoping you'd want to come with me when I do, on account of your connection.

118.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_004
118.description: When you're up for it, let me know.

119.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_000
119.description: Everyone in the village was overjoyed to receive our supplies! Both the quality and quantity surpassed their expectations!

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_001
120.description: It puts my mind at ease to know that the tribe has what it needs, and that we'll be able to continue sending regular payments to the beneficiaries of our fund for the foreseeable future...

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_002
121.description: Mother? What are you doing here in the Reach?

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MHAHTOA_004_003
122.description: I know you're awfully busy with your duties and the fund, but there was something I wanted to say when you visited before, but couldn't.

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MHAHTOA_004_004
123.description: Come home, Naago. Ala Mhigo is free. You've done enough for these people. Come home and be with your family again.

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_005
124.description: But Mother, I...I have responsibilities here...

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MHAHTOA_004_006
125.description: To the families of your comrades, I know. And I think what you're doing is wonderful, but...I worry you place their needs ahead of your own. You deserve to live your own life─to do what you want. What makes you happy.

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_007
126.description: I am doing what makes me happy, Mother, don't you see? Helping these people in this way─and there's so much more we can do!

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_008
127.description: I know it's not the life you had in mind for me. It's not what I had in mind when I was younger either. But after everything I've been through, everything I've shared with my brothers- and sisters-in-arms...I can't just walk away.

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_009
128.description: It won't make up for what they've lost. No amount of gil weighs the same as a loved one's soul. But...it's better than nothing...

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_016
129.description: So no, I won't go back. This is the life I chose, and I've no regrets.

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MHAHTOA_004_010
130.description: ...Still have that same fire in your eyes and steel in your voice you had when you said you wanted to join the Resistance. <sigh> Can't blame a mother for trying, can you?

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MHAHTOA_004_011
131.description: I respect your decision, and I'll say no more on it. All I ask is that you come and visit more. Much more.

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_012
132.description: I'll see what I can do, Mother.

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_013
133.description: Well, that was...unexpected...though not entirely unwelcome. It's good to remember where you came from, and why you did what you did.

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_014
134.description: Anyway, now that we've finished with our efforts to help my village, I'd like to concentrate our efforts solely on doing what we can for the Resistance and the families in need.

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_015
135.description: With your help, that is. Assuming I can still count on it?

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_017
136.description: Whatever you're able and willing to provide is all I ask, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_100
137.description: We did well with those Gridanian collectors, but we'll need to expand if we want to continue raising money for the fund. In short, I'd like to start dealing in Far Eastern collectables.

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_101
138.description: Apparently, according to General Aldynn, there are a number of wealthy individuals in Ul'dah with a deep and abiding love for all things Hingan.

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_102
139.description: It goes without saying that the Ul'dahn elite have more gil to spend than their Gridanian counterparts on average, so I expect we can turn a greater profit with this venture.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_103
140.description: It'll be more work than before, but I know you're up to the task!

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_100
141.description: Like before, I reckon it'd be for the best if we tried to trade in a more diverse range of collectables. Next, I'm thinking we ought to try our hand at consolation prizes from the Gold Saucer.

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_101
142.description: I trust you're familiar with the Saucer and its many delights? It's no secret, but in case you were unaware, it employs more than a few Ala Mhigans.

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_102
143.description: One of them happens to be a friend of mine. I mentioned the fund one day, and just like that, we got ourselves a new partner in crime.

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_103
144.description: Let me explain. There are prizes available only at the Gold Saucer─commodities sold exclusively to them by certain select suppliers. We're now one of them, savvy?

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_104
145.description: I'll wager you didn't think a soldier like me had any truck with places like the Saucer, eh? Bet you're wondering if I might run off with our profits and spend it all on MGP and silly hats?

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_105
146.description: With hair like this? Like hells I will.

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_106
147.description: All right, enough talk. Let's get to work!

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_100
148.description: So, I imagine you're wondering exactly what sort of deliveries I had in mind...

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_101
149.description: Frankly, I say why not focus on ourselves and what the Resistance could use? Materiel's always appreciated, among other things.

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_102
150.description: Rebuilding Ala Mhigo's going to take everything we can muster. Artisans like you will have a reliable client in us.

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_LCUT_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_103
151.description: Everything you've got and more, we'll take it!

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_000_000
152.description: M'naago is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Supporter of the Resistance Widows and Orphans Fund<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_000_001
153.description: M'naago is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Benefactor of the Resistance Widows and Orphans Fund<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_000_002
154.description: M'naago is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of the Resistance Widows and Orphans Fund<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_000_003
155.description: M'naago could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Champion of Widows and Orphans<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_001_001
156.description: And yet there is still much work to be done before the fund can provide sufficient aid to all the families of the deceased. To that end, M'naago has a new favor to ask of you...

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUPINFO_001_002
157.description: Through your efforts, the fund will provide substantial benefits to the families of the fallen Resistance fighters for some time. It seems, however, that M'naago has a different sort of favor to ask of you...

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTRANKUP_000_001
158.description: The Custom Deliveries list for M'naago has been updated. To view the new list, speak with M'naago and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTRANKUP_001_001
159.description: A new quest continuing the story of the Resistance Widows and Orphans Fund is now available. Upon its completion, the Custom Deliveries list for M'naago will be updated.

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTRANKUP_002_001
160.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTRANKUP_002_002
161.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with M'naago and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTRANKUP_002_003
162.description: Note that Resistance materiel, yellow kudzu roots, and purple bucklers will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_000
163.description: Got to say, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you've done more than your fair share for the fund.

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_001_001
164.description: Wouldn't want to impose upon you further, not right now. Rest up and come 'round another time, all right?

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_000
165.description: I don't know how you can keep it up, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Honestly! You're a veritable fountain of endless energy.

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_002_001
166.description: But I'll not hear it said that I'm keeping you all to myself. You've got places to go and other people to help. Take care, and thanks again!

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_000
167.description: You're a godssend, you know that? All you've done for us, all you continue to do. There's no better word for it.

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_001
168.description: Still, I wager it's not entirely out of the kindness of your heart, eh? You enjoy the collectables trade─exhausting though it may be, there's still a solid sense of accomplishment. I know the feeling.

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_003_002
169.description: But we both ought to know by now that it's important not to overdo it. Take a rest, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>─you've earned it.

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_000
170.description: I've said it before, but I'll say it again: thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_001
171.description: At first I didn't quite understand what could drive wealthy collectors to spend gil hand over fist on fancy trinkets. But when I thought about the time and effort you poured into your craft, and me into mine, it started to make sense...

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_004_002
172.description: Anyway, let's you and me keep our noses to the grindstone!

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_005_000
173.description: Ye gods, you're relentless! Like a machine at times, even!

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_005_001
174.description: As for me, some of the lads were heard to say more...merchanty these days? Stubborn and hard-nosed as ever, but somehow in a more mercantile sense.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_005_002
175.description: I suppose I ought to take it as a compliment. For the longest time I thought I only had hunting and soldiering in my veins, so it comes as a bit of a relief to find I've got a knack for something else...

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_006_000
176.description: By Rhalgr, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Do you ever sleep, or do you just prefer to stay awake indefinitely putting us all to shame?

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_006_001
177.description: Heh, now that I think on it, we've been doing this for quite some time now, haven't we?

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_006_002
178.description: I mean, the goal's still the same, but the fund's grown leaps and bounds beyond what I originally envisioned...

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_006_003
179.description: It was only ever supposed to be a means to an end, you know? But somewhere along the line, I found myself taking joy in it all. Meeting new people, finding ways to satisfy their needs, watching them go home happy...

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_RANKUP_MNAAGO_006_004
180.description: It's good, honest work, all the way through, and I hope to keep doing it for a good while yet─with your help, of course!

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER2_00434_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
181.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to M'naago. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
